cc_tmux.owner_text: 授权一次受限原生场景
cc_tmux.scope: One current-version native scenario wave covering normal, auth-or-unsent negative, controlled failure and cancellation using the currently enabled Claude hooks. Honcho and claude-mem may create or update session, peer, message, service and state records caused by those exact scenario sessions and prompts.
cc_tmux.retention_and_cleanup: Record exact scenario/session identities and available hook-created record identities. External memory records are retained as authorized test evidence and must not be deleted as cleanup. Cleanup is limited to exact-owned tmux sessions, watchers, locks and temporary runtime state.
required: Attribute or keep BLOCKED any ~/.claude.json drift.
Preserve all pre-existing tmux sessions and Claude processes.
Do not change hooks, plugins, settings, credentials or provider configuration.
Do not claim scenario acceptance from launch, submission or cleanup alone.
forbidden: deleting or rewriting pre-existing Honcho or claude-mem data
Hermes, Gateway, Kanban or call-omp mutation
